caveats.R@100: R@100 is pool-relative recall under incomplete judgments, not corpus-wide recall.
caveats.ancillary_judges: Gemma E4B is ancillary; GPT is comparison only because GPT authored the queries. Neither enters canonical qrels.
caveats.candidate_universe: The E5 run uses a text-only index, while the full index also includes media. The runs do not share an equal candidate universe. Consult corpus_summary.json for this experiment for document and code-document counts.
caveats.judge_independence: Gemini and Gemma12 provide independent initial grading but share the same provider (Google model family); the Gemini review is within-model, not a third independent judge.
caveats.no_answer: No-answer queries remain in qrels and are reported separately; they are excluded from answerable-query retrieval averages.
caveats.pool: Depth-10 union of all frozen systems. Unjudged documents outside this pool are treated as nonrelevant by the metric evaluator; judgments are incomplete beyond the pool.
caveats.target_coverage: Target construction coverage is reported dynamically in target_diagnostics. The corpus may contain modalities without authored targets. Target-grade diagnostics use only targets actually present in the judged pool.
caveats.ties: System scores within absolute tolerance 1e-12 share a rank; alphabetical order within a tie has no ranking meaning.
caveats.zero_relevant: Answerable queries with no positive grade in the judged pool score zero and remain in the retrieval average.
